hero_intro: Whether you're just getting started or ready to make yoga part of your routine, there's a membership that fits.
newcomer_intro: Unlimited classes for 21 days, every style. Bring a friend for free, with no auto-renewal. The easiest way to find your feet.
benefits_intro: Everything we do is designed to help you enjoy your practice and keep coming back.
benefit_mood: Whether you want to build strength, slow down or simply switch off, you'll always find a class that feels right.
benefit_temperature: One studio with three ways to practise. Choose the room temperature you enjoy most, whatever class you attend.
benefit_welcome: No experience, no pressure and no expectation to be "good at yoga." Just friendly teachers who meet you where you are.
benefit_community: From workshops and retreats to everyday conversations before and after class, it's a studio where people genuinely know each other.
benefit_teachers: Every teacher brings their own personality and experience while sharing the same welcoming approach.
benefit_home: Members also get access to our on-demand library, so your practice doesn't stop when you can't make it to the studio.
help_intro: Whether you're choosing your first membership or just have a question, get in touch. We'll point you in the right direction, with no pressure.
